On March 6, 2026, President Nasry Juan Asfura of Honduras signed the ICSID Convention in Washington, D.C., making Honduras the 166th Signatory State to the Convention. top3.heading: ICSID
top3.text: ICSID membership is considered a positive factor in MIGA’s risk assessment for insurance guarantees and the World Bank Group’s overall assessment of countries’ investment landscape. ICSID membership supports States’ policies to attract and retain foreign direct investment to create more job opportunities and economic growth. top3.heading: SHARING KNOWLEDGE, SUPPORTING PRACTITIONERS AND POLICYMAKERS
top3.text: In fiscal 2026, ICSID published its first in-depth study on contract-based investment dispute resolution, drawing on an analysis of 175 cases registered under the ICSID Convention and Additional Facility. The background paper examines how contract-based dispute resolution has worked in practice at ICSID, serving as both an analytical guide and practical reference for investors, States, and State entities. Key findings show that contract-based arbitrations at ICSID are more time-efficient than the overall caseload, averaging 40 months from registration to conclusion compared to 47, and settle or discontinue at a higher rate, 43 percent versus 34 percent. The paper is accompanied by a special issue of the ICSID Caseload – Statistics featuring data on contract-based cases.
